meta.title: BlütenSturm · Creative Agency Würzburg — Brands in full bloom
meta.description: BlütenSturm is the creative agency from Würzburg: brand strategy, digital marketing, content & social, events and corporate training for the Mittelstand in Germany and Europe.

cta.bandText: Brand, campaign, event or academy programme: send us the brief and we come back with a route, a team and a number.

hero.title:
Brands in
full bloom.
hero.sub: Marketing, creative and corporate training from Würzburg. With the rigour of consultants and the nerve of artists.

about.title:
Franconian roots.
European reach.
about.p1: BlütenSturm was founded in Würzburg, a city of vineyards, baroque stone and stubborn craft. We kept the craft and added velocity. Today we work with Mittelstand leaders, challenger brands and institutions that need marketing that moves markets, and teams able to carry it.
about.p2: One team, three disciplines: creative that gets remembered. Strategy that gets signed off. Training that stays inside the organisation.
about.f2v: German and English, plus FR · ES · IT

services.title:
Five disciplines.
One team.
services.lead: Book one or let us run the whole stack: from positioning workshop to performance dashboard. Every card opens scope and packages.
services.dirNote: 18 services with indicative prices for the Bavarian market. Pick one to read scope and packages.

why.title: Agencies pitch ideas. We are accountable for outcomes.
why.1p: Every creative route is tied to a commercial thesis you can defend to a board.
why.2p: German and English from one desk, DACH nuance, EU-wide rollout without translation drift.
why.3p: The people in the pitch are the people on the work. No handover to juniors.
why.4p: Campaigns end. Capability stays: your team can run it themselves afterwards.
why.caption: A B made of three petals: stem, bloom and storm share one root.

work.title: Recent storms.
work.lead: Our case studies are anonymised at our clients' request. The full portfolio is available under NDA.
work.1p: A family-owned Franconian manufacturer with a strong product and a name nobody outside Germany could place. Positioning workshop, new brand architecture and a bilingual identity system, rolled out across sales, trade fair and web in one season.
work.2p: A product launch in Germany, Austria and Switzerland: one creative idea, adapted per market rather than translated, with paid media, landing pages and sales material measured against pipeline, not impressions.
work.3p: Modules I and II, delivered over twelve months in German and English. New and scaling leaders in small cohorts, real cases from their own floor, and a handover so the next round runs in-house.
work.4p: Two days, three stages and a hybrid stream: concept, programme, staging and content for a client's annual summit, from the first sketch to the last cable.
work.note: Names, figures and imagery for each case are available on request and in confidence.

partners.title: Brands we move.
partners.lead: Distribution partnerships across the Balkans: marketing budget, creative, media and sell-out held in one place. 44 brands, eight categories; a logo opens the work behind it.

panel.summary: A distribution partnership run out of the Balkans: we sit between the brand and the regional distributor, hold the marketing budget, and are measured on what leaves the shelf rather than on what was posted.
work: Distribution partnerships managed across the Balkan markets
Marketing budgets held and reported for Albania and Kosovo
Creative content produced for social media, in local language
Paid advertising planned, run and optimised against sell-out
In-store and seasonal promotions built with the distributor
Sales managed through the campaign calendar, reported month by month

academy.title: Training that outlives the campaign.
academy.lead: Modular programmes for leadership, communication, customer care, sales and marketing. In German or English, in Würzburg, on your site or hybrid across Europe.
academy.formats: Half-day, one-day and two-day modules · small groups · real cases from your own business · a certificate for every participant.
academy.m1p: Decision-making, delegation and conflict: for new and scaling leaders.
academy.m2p: Narrative structure, pitch craft and presence, on camera and in the room.
academy.m3p: Positioning, channels and budgets for founders and department heads.
academy.m4p: Service standards, difficult conversations, complaints and the handover back to sales.

process.title: Three steps to kick-off.
process.1p: This form, an e-mail or the questionnaire: whichever is fastest for you.
process.2p: Within two working days you get an approach, the team and a from-price.
process.3p: A workshop in Würzburg, at your site or online. Then the work starts.

Thank you. The storm
is already gathering.
